'''Sude Raalo''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] arms merchant who operated out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] spaceport on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He operated as a supplier for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and as a go-between for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Raalo was considered to be a relatively honest trader.

==History==
Sude hired a group to find the derelict battleship ''[[Starworm]]'' after buying the coordinates from his smuggler friend, [[Vordell]]. He was specifically interested in retrieving any remote processors that could control [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. He owned a [[Sude Raalo's YT-1300 transport|beat-up YT-1300 light freighter]] that he lived out of.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
